note: Golden samples of the pre-084 home terrain (plan 084): rng seed 84, radius 600 km. Heights and lake levels as float64 SHA-256 (bit-exact on the Apple arm64 machines that recorded them), the first 200 heights, and every 5th height and lake level (2 000 each, written on the M5 where the SHA-256 matched) for the tolerant cross-platform check; biome map SHA-256 per width. Heights re-recorded by plan 417 (finer hill and ridge octaves, cliff terraces); the lake levels and maps are unchanged.
